items.html: *It was already explained above that AA is now revealed from his Tabur downward, which is the bottom third of the bottom Hey in him, and when he wished to clothe through ZON, who are the garments in which his bottom half clothes as mentioned, he wished to correct ZON. And to correct them, what did he do? First, Atik Yomin gathered the two middle joints of his Netzah and Hod, which were clothed within the Netzah and Hod of Arich, as mentioned, and raised them above and clothed them onto the first two joints of his own Netzah and Hod, which are clothed in the Hesed and Gevura of Arich as mentioned there.
